title: Twin Babies Sitting on Rocky Ground Outdoors, 1928 Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
MAXWELL C. PEEL
PHOTO SERVICE
SEP 4 1928
description: An outdoor full-length snapshot capturing two young babies (likely twins) seated amid rugged rocks, gravel, and sparse scrub vegetation. Both are dressed in matching light-colored rompers, socks, and soft-soled baby shoes, squinting under bright natural sunlight against a weathered stone backdrop and slender sapling. The reverse features album adhesive residue and a purple photographer/developer ink stamp from Maxwell C. Peel Photo Service dated September 1928.
